title: A small algorithm, with conditions we must check.
content: A small algorithm, with conditions we must check.

choose X in the target support
repeat N times:
    draw candidate J from Q[X, :]
    draw U uniformly in (0, 1)
    if U < alpha(X, J):
        X = J
    record X
Use the MH rule above; set α(X, X) = 1.

Both states communicate.

The chain is irreducible and aperiodic.
